paperfolding_definition: p_n=0 iff the odd part of n is 1 mod 4; p_n=1 iff it is 3 mod 4, for n>=1
prefix_balance_identity: sum_{j=1}^n a_j equals the number of runs in the standard binary expansion of n for n>=1
published_conjecture_note: The printed Conjecture 6.5 allows i=0; the theorem proves the parity-corrected form i>=1. Nonempty Dyck words have even length.
